thesis: Treat the show as a mindful groove progression where stable spatial anchors and breathing fades create a grounded 'just be' state before each controlled rise.

artist_branding.summary: HAUMS reads as melodic-progressive dance with balanced warmth and drive: clean low-end propulsion, understated drama, and emotionally clear transitions rather than aggressive maximalism.
visual_cues: Steady hypnotic pulse with gradual phrase growth
Teal-blue and soft amber interplay for calm-to-confident movement
Minimal clutter and readable structure in mid-energy sections
do_not_copy: Do not replicate exact promo visual edits, stage branding, or signature artist cue structure from official sets.

motifs: Geometry motif: recurring center holds with gentle lateral breathing
Color motif: cool cyan base warmed by restrained amber confirmations
Movement motif: long phrase exhales followed by concise per-bar lift gestures

visual_direction.color_story: Begin in meditative cool tones, fold in warm highlights at key phrase arrivals, and preserve white as occasional clarity punctuation.
visual_direction.motion_story: Use mostly smooth transitions through introspective bars, then shift to tighter rhythmic movement when chorus/drop energy arrives.
visual_direction.staging_story: Keep PARs stable for emotional bed while mover pairs alternate call-and-response to imply breathing space.

must_include: A clearly restrained opening section with low visual density
Phrase-aware expansion that never abandons calm center readability
At least one chorus-family section where warmth enters as earned contrast
avoid: Hyperactive motion in every bar of the arrangement
Heavy strobe-led looks across contemplative or vocal-led phrases
Chaotic multi-palette jumps that disrupt the grounded concept
